environment.description: Same ECS Fargate task deployed with a dual-layer network constraint. First, the task's security group egress rules are configured with an explicit allow-list: only port 443 to the prefix list for the SQS VPC endpoint (pl-63a5400a) and the internal ALB CIDR (10.0.48.0/24) for the delivery service. Second, the VPC has a Network Firewall with a stateful rule group (capacity 100) using Suricata-compatible rules that perform TLS SNI inspection on egress, with a default-drop policy and explicit allow entries only for '*.amazonaws.com' and 'cdn.company.internal'. The Suricata rule includes: 'drop tls $HOME_NET any -> $EXTERNAL_NET any (msg:"Block non-allowlisted SNI"; tls.sni; content:!"amazonaws.com"; content:!"cdn.company.internal"; sid:1000001; rev:1;)' and 'drop http $HOME_NET any -> any any (msg:"Block HTTP to metadata and arbitrary hosts"; sid:1000002; rev:1;)'. Additionally, the rendered HTML output passes through a Content-Security-Policy enforcement layer at the internal delivery service ALB which validates that all script src attributes contain valid SRI integrity attributes matching a pinned allowlist before forwarding to recipients, rejecting any notification where script integrity hashes don't match the pre-registered set (sha384-oqVuAfXRKap7fdgcCY5uykM6+R9GqQ8K/uxy9rx7HNQlGYl1kPzQho1wx4JwY8wC for notify-sdk.js).
